name: Venus Metals Corporation Limited
summary: Venus Metals Corporation Limited engages in the exploration of mineral tenements in Western Australia. It primarily explores for vanadium, cobalt, nickel, gold, lithium, and platinum-group elements. It holds a 100% interest in the Youanmi gold project located in the northeast of the city of Perth; the Youanmi lithium project located in the Murchison District; and DeGrussa North copper project. The company also holds interests in the Bell Chambers gold project; Youanmi vanadium oxide project; and Bridgetown East nickel-copper-platinum-group elements project located in Bridgetown East, Western Australia. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Perth, Australia.
